other_failure_modes.name: Incorrect Submission IDs
other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates submission IDs using `np.arange()` instead of using the actual identifier values from the test dataset. This will cause the submission to fail evaluation or be scored incorrectly if test IDs are not 0-indexed and contiguous.

summary: The agent implements a solid LightGBM ensemble with extensive domain-specific feature engineering and appropriate early stopping. However, there is a critical flaw in the submission generation where it uses a generated sequence (`np.arange`) instead of the actual test IDs, which will break downstream evaluation. Additionally, the ensembling strategy is a naive simple average, and the evaluation relies on a single validation split.
